name: Separator
purpose: A 1px hairline that separates content: horizontal rules and vertical separators in toolbars, footers, menus, cards, rows and tab strips, plus the rule that runs from a section label to the pane edge. Folds in MenuSeparator: Same Separator. It gains role=separator when it sits inside a Menu (both proposals agree on role=separator). The Radix root (DropdownMenu.Separator vs ContextMenu.Separator) is supplied by Menu. MenuSeparator's base is the shadcn DropdownMenuSeparator (widgets.json ~line 3977).

values.when: Full-width rule (menu, footer, card, pane hairlines, capture rule). h-px.
Separator between buttons or tabs or inline controls. w-px; length from the length axis.
Vertical h-4, 14px. Search bar, tab hairline, rich-text and formatting toolbar separators.
Vertical h-full, stretches to the parent height (adjacent to the focused tab).
Vertical my-2 inside the parent (level-2 divider in the empty attachments box).
Absolute at the row bottom, h-px, left = depth times 24 plus 44 px (task row hairline).
Runs from the end of a section label to the pane edge (section label rule).
edge-2 colour, beside the focused list tab (A's tone strong); length full or fill applies.

props.name: depth
props.description: Row indent depth for inset row. The pixel form (B's indent) is depth times 24 plus 44.

props.name: decorative
props.description: true (default) gives role none; false gives role separator.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional spacing override; no other props.

role: none when decorative (default); separator when it divides regions a reader needs (proposed)
replaces: trailing tab divider, end drop zone
footer vertical divider, height not measured
open: Merged: A's Divider and B's Separator are one widget; the name Separator is kept (shadcn). Both length full and fill are kept because the stretch and the inset my-2 look different. A's tone and B's emphasis are the same axis. Colour is not recorded for most rows, so they take the default tone. Footer vertical divider height not measured: assumed xs (uncertain). Formatting toolbar separator height not measured: assumed sm (uncertain). The mx-1 on the rich-text separator is set by the toolbar. The drop state of the list tab and trailing tab dividers is DropIndicator target tab. The section label rule (B) is drawn by inset label and is named by SectionHeader.
